title: fix(runtime)!: a member removed from an environment is refused on their next request

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DLUj5j31KxtvHnUctstoqES)_

Fixes #32230

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no published skill teaches the environment-membership check (git grep over skills/ for the check, its error code and the member object: 0 hits)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:多环境部署中,环境成员检查对每一次请求都按成员表的当前状态判断,不再沿用之前请求的放行结果;一个人被移出环境后,他的下一次请求即被拒绝,所有副本一致。
- 为什么改:被移出环境的人不应在移出之后还能继续访问该环境。
- 风险与回滚:收紧方向。每个环境内请求多一次按唯一键的成员查询;成员表所在存储不可用期间,环境内请求得到可重试的 503。匿名请求、系统环境、关闭检查的部署不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts(judgeMembershipOf 开头与成员判定处)、packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher-membership-revocation.test.ts、.changeset/environment-membership-removal-next-request.md
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/http-dispatcher-membership-revocation.test.ts`,预期 7 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The rule: **a membership change takes effect on the next request.** On a host that enforces environment membership, the check judges every scoped request against the membership store as it stands and carries no admission from one request to the next. So a member removed from an environment is refused on their next request, on every replica serving it, and a request whose membership the store cannot answer is the outage (`AuthzStoreUnavailableError`, `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`), never "allowed", whoever was admitted a moment before.

- `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts`: `judgeMembershipOf` reads `sys_environment_member` for every judged request and keeps no admission between requests. Both doors that share the judgment (`dispatch()` and the declarative-endpoint step `environmentMembershipRefusal`) follow the rule.
- Unchanged: anonymous requests, the well-known system environment, members of the platform organization, hosts with `enforceProjectMembership: false`, compositions that register no environment-member object, the 403 `PROJECT_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED` answer and the fail-closed read (#21941).
- `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.test.ts`: a case that pinned the earlier behaviour now pins the rule (a member removed between two calls is refused on the second).
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts`: one comment no longer names a membership answer kept between requests, and a side-effect import the test-source alias lint requires. No assertion changes.
- `.changeset/environment-membership-removal-next-request.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/runtime`, `!` summary, BREAKING paragraph with "Who moves", ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker.

## Tests

`packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher-membership-revocation.test.ts` (new, 7 cases, named by the rule):

- a member admitted on one request and then removed is refused on the very next request;
- every replica serving the environment refuses the removed member on its next request (two dispatchers over one membership store);
- the declarative-endpoint step applies the same rule;
- a member admitted a moment ago is answered 503 when the membership store cannot answer, never admitted;
- a member removed and added back is admitted again on the next request;
- CONTROL: a member who stays a member is admitted on consecutive requests; the system environment stays open to a signed-in caller who holds no membership row.

**Ablation** (one-shot, not kept): with the rule removed from the committed fix, 4 of the 7 cases go red, the four the rule decides; the re-add case and both CONTROL cases stay green. Restored: blob equal to `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- Ruling: the maintainer chose option A on the card's release question on 2026-11-12 22:56Z, in the maintainer's own words 「A 去掉缓存,进 18.4.0」 (drop the cache, ship in 18.4.0), accepting one membership lookup per judged request and the retriable `503` while the membership store is unreachable. The seat's relay of it is claim comment 6838259317 on #32230.
- A future reuse of membership answers would have to meet the authorization-cache rule `resolve-authz-context.ts` states (cache a success only behind seams that observe the writes it depends on, with a TTL as the residual bound); the code comment at the read says so.
